title: Almec
description: Serving as Prime Minister of a peaceful Mandalore, it was the task of Almec to enforce controversial policies of Duchess Satine Kryze of peace, pacifism, and neutrality for the people of Mandalore. While he worked to fend off the predations of Death Watch and preached against the barbaric violence of Mandalore's past, he led the government into corruption, allowing a thriving black market network of goods that caused the death of children. Thrown into prison for his heinous crimes, Almec was later installed as a puppet leader with Darth Maul pulling his strings.
